definition_zh: 最近；近来；不久前；最近这段时间
definition_en: in the recent past, usually up to the present moment
core_image: 日历上最近几格被圈起来，昨天和前天都还没干透的笔迹
scene: 朋友在电话里问起他的近况，他想了想，说最近事情特别多，好久没出去旅行了。Things have been rather quiet at the office lately.
sceneCN: 这里 lately 表示「最近、近来」（第 1 个义项：从过去不久到现在的这段时间）；句意为：最近办公室里相当安静。

pos.zh: 副词：最近；近来；不久前

derivatives.zh: lately 去掉副词词尾 -ly 得到的基础形容词，义为「晚的；迟的；近期的」
在 late 后加比较词尾 -er 构成，义为「后来；以后」
在 late 后加最高级词尾 -est 构成，义为「最新的；最近的」
在 late 后加名词词尾 -ness 构成，义为「迟到；迟」

senses.title: In the recent period up to now
senses.definition: during the period that has just passed and is still going on
senses.definitionCN: 在刚刚过去的、目前仍在延续的那段时间里
senses.example: He has looked tired lately, though nobody knows why.
senses.exampleCN: 他最近看起来很累，可没人知道为什么。
senses.why: Late gives the sense of near in time, and the ly ending makes it an adverb of the recent stretch.
senses.whyCN: late 提供「时间上近」的意思，加上副词词尾就成了指最近这段时间的副词。

senses.title: Not long ago
senses.definition: at a point shortly before the present, rather than over a period
senses.definitionCN: 指现在之前不久的某个时间点，而不是一段持续期
senses.example: She only lately learned the truth about the house.
senses.exampleCN: 她直到不久前才弄清这座房子的真相。
senses.why: The same time word can name a single recent moment instead of a stretch.
senses.whyCN: 同一个时间词也可以指最近的某一个时刻，而不只是一段时间。

senses.title: With a change just noticed
senses.definition: signals that a state is new or a change has appeared in the near past
senses.definitionCN: 暗示某种状态是新出现的，或变化在不久前才发生
senses.example: The neighbours have been unusually friendly lately.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们最近出奇地友好。
senses.why: Pointing at the recent period invites the listener to compare it with what came before.
senses.whyCN: 指向最近这段时间，就自然邀请听者把它与之前的状态作比较。

senses.title: In questions about news
senses.definition: used in questions asking whether something has happened in the recent period
senses.definitionCN: 用于询问某事在最近这段时间里是否发生过
senses.example: Have you seen the old boatman lately?
senses.exampleCN: 你最近见过那位老船夫吗？
senses.why: A recent stretch is the natural window for a question about news.
senses.whyCN: 最近这段时间正是打听近况时最自然的观察窗口。

senses.title: In negatives about absence
senses.titleCN: 否定句中表示「好久没有」
senses.definition: in a negative statement, stresses that something has not happened for some time
senses.definitionCN: 在否定说法里强调某事已经有一段时间没有发生
senses.example: We have not heard from him lately, which worries us.
senses.exampleCN: 我们最近没收到他的消息，这让我们很担心。
senses.why: The negative plus the adverb says the absence itself has lasted through the recent period.
senses.whyCN: 否定词加上这个副词，说明「没有发生」这件事贯穿了最近这段时间。

senses.title: Inside an until phrase
senses.titleCN: 用于 until 引导的短语中
senses.definition: in the frame until lately, meaning up to a point shortly before now
senses.definitionCN: 用于 until recently 的框架中，表示直到不久前为止
senses.example: Until lately the whole road was closed to traffic.
senses.exampleCN: 直到不久前，整条路都对车辆封闭。
senses.why: An older state ends when the frame is used, which is why the adverb fits a boundary.
senses.whyCN: 使用这个框架时，某种旧状态就此结束，所以副词正好用来标出分界。

senses.title: In a long negation merely for emphasis
senses.definition: in patterns such as not merely lately, meaning that something is not a new habit at all
senses.definitionCN: 用于表示「并非最近才如此」的句式里，强调某种情况早已存在
senses.example: The cracks were not merely lately formed; they are decades old.
senses.exampleCN: 这些裂缝并不是最近才出现的，它们已经有几十年的历史了。
senses.why: Naming the recent window lets a speaker deny that the change is new.
senses.whyCN: 点出「最近」这个时间窗口，说话人就能否认这种变化是新发生的。

senses.title: In formal written registers
senses.definition: used in reports and letters to describe conditions over the past few months
senses.definitionCN: 在报告与书信里用来描述过去几个月的情况
senses.example: Receipts have lately risen while the volume of goods has fallen.
senses.exampleCN: 最近收入有所上升，而货物数量却在下降。
senses.why: Written registers often keep the adverb before the verb, which gives it a formal tone.
senses.whyCN: 书面语常把副词放在动词之前，这一位置赋予它正式的语调。

senses.title: With a shorter period than recently
senses.titleCN: 比 recently 更短的时间跨度
senses.definition: often suggests a shorter and more conversational time span than the formal twin
senses.definitionCN: 所指的时间跨度常比正式的近义词更短，语气也更口语
senses.example: It has rained a lot lately, so the river is high.
senses.exampleCN: 最近雨下得很多，所以河水涨得很高。
senses.why: Speech tends to look at the last few weeks, while longer prose looks back over months.
senses.whyCN: 口语往往只看最近几周，而较长的书面文字会回顾好几个月。

intro.en: Lately is the adverb built on late, an old English word for slow or delayed, with the common ly ending; over time the pair split into a word about timing and a word about the recent past.
intro.cn: lately 是由古老的英语单词 late（迟的、晚的）加常见副词词尾 ly 构成的副词；久而久之，两者分道扬镳：一个管时间早晚，一个管刚刚过去的一段。

items.en: A reconstructed adjective meaning slow or sluggish is the ancestor of late in the older Germanic languages.
items.cn: 一个意为「迟缓、迟钝」的日耳曼语重构形容词，是 late 在较早日耳曼语中的祖先。

items.en: In Old English the adjective meant slow or tardy, a sense still felt in the phrase be late.
items.cn: 古英语中这个形容词意为迟缓、迟到，今天 still be late 这样的说法里还能感觉到这层意思。

items.en: The adjective widened to mean happening after the expected time, and a ly adverb carried the same idea.
items.cn: 该形容词扩展为「在预期时间之后发生」，加 ly 的副词承载了同样的意思。

items.en: The adverb came to mean during the time just past; writers already used it in that sense.
items.cn: 该副词开始表示「在刚刚过去的时间里」，当时的文字中已有这种用法。

items.en: The pair split: late kept the sense of after the right time, lately became a marker of the recent period.
items.cn: 两词分工：late 保留「晚于恰当时间」的意思，lately 则成为标记最近一段时间的词。

items.en: Today it favours spoken and semi-formal writing, while the longer twin dominates academic prose.
items.cn: 今天它多见于口语和半正式文字，而更长的同义词则在学术文章中占主导。

note.en: The first group is built from the same adjective late and its endings; the second group lists other adverbs for time that has just passed.
note.cn: 第一组由同一个形容词 late 及其各种词尾构成；第二组列举其他表示「刚刚过去的时间」的副词。

entries.definition: after the expected time; the adjective behind this adverb
entries.definitionCN: 晚于预期时间；本词背后的形容词。

entries.definition: at a time after now or after a stated time
entries.definitionCN: 在现在或所述时间之后，是比较级形式。

entries.definition: the most recent in a series
entries.definitionCN: 一系列中最新、最近的，是最高级形式。

entries.definition: the quality of being late
entries.definitionCN: 迟到的状态，是加名词词尾构成的派生词。

entries.definition: the formal twin for the recent past
entries.definitionCN: 表示最近过去的正式说法，常指更长的时间跨度。

entries.definition: very lately, with the emphasis on the new state
entries.definitionCN: 表示刚刚发生，强调状态之新。

entries.definition: very lately, often of things just made or done
entries.definitionCN: 表示刚刚完成，常指新做好的东西。

normalIntro.en: Lately is late plus the ly ending, and it asks what has happened in the time just behind you.
normalIntro.cn: lately 就是 late 加 ly 词尾，它问的是就在你身后这段时间里发生了什么。

normal.en: Late plus ly: the word points to the tail end of time, nearest to now.
normal.cn: late 加 ly：这个词指向时间的尾端，也就是离现在最近的地方。

normal.en: The base word keeps the sense of delayed, so this form borrows only the closeness to now.
normal.cn: 基础词保留「迟到」的意思，这个派生的副词只借用了「靠近现在」这一层。

normal.en: Compare late, later and latest: the endings change the direction of time.
normal.cn: 对比 late、later、latest：词尾一变，时间的指向就变了。

normal.en: Only lately and until lately are common frames in which the word appears.
normal.cn: only lately 和 until lately 是这个词常见的两个框架。

normal.en: In British English it is more frequent in speech, while the longer twin uses in reports.
normal.cn: 在英式英语里它更多见于口语，而更长的同义词多用于报告。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar with only the last few squares circled in pen.
abstract.cn: 想象一张日历，只把最后几格用笔圈了起来。

abstract.en: Think of a friend saying that something has changed since your last meeting.
abstract.cn: 想象朋友说，自上次见面以来有些事变了。

abstract.en: A question with this word opens a window onto the last few weeks of a life.
abstract.cn: 带上这个词的提问，就像打开一扇窥看别人近几周的窗。

examples.en: She has been unusually quiet lately.
examples.cn: 她最近异常安静。

examples.en: Have you been to the new market lately?
examples.cn: 你最近去过新开的市场吗？

examples.en: Until lately the farm had no running water.
examples.cn: 直到不久前，这个农场还没有自来水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「累特利」——最近特别累，late 加 ly 变成 recently 的意思：最近；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: late 来自日耳曼语系中意为「迟缓」的形容词，古英语里写作表示「慢、迟」的形式，中古英语中扩展为「晚于预期时间」；加副词词尾 -ly 后形成 lately，语义转向「最近、近来」，与 late 分工。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses start from the recent period, then narrow to a single recent moment, a noticed change, question and negative patterns, frame phrases, emphasis, formal registers and the shorter time span it suggests.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从最近这段时间开始，依次收窄到某个最近的时刻、被察觉的变化、提问与否定的句式、固定框架、强调用法、正式语域，以及它暗示的较短时间跨度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the last few squares of a calendar circled in fresh ink.
core.cn: 核心意象：日历上最后几格被新鲜墨水圈起来。

branches.en: THE RECENT STRETCH: the plain sense of the time just passed.
branches.cn: 最近这段时间：刚刚过去那段时间的基本义。

branches.en: A SINGLE RECENT MOMENT: set inside until phrases, the word marks a point, not a span.
branches.cn: 某个最近的时刻：放进 until 一类的框架里，它标的是时间点而非时间段。

branches.en: A CHANGE AND ITS ABSENCE: a new state or a missing one is set against the recent past.
branches.cn: 变化的有无：新出现的状态或迟迟未至的事情，都与最近这段时间相比照。

branches.en: QUESTION AND EMPHASIS: the word frames a query or denies that something is new.
branches.cn: 提问与强调：它构成提问，也能否掉「这是新事」的说法。

branches.en: REGISTER AND SPAN: formal prose places it before the verb, and it suggests a shorter span than its formal twin.
branches.cn: 语域与跨度：正式文字把它放在动词之前，而它的时间跨度比正式同义词更短。

intro.en: This is a native English formation: the old adjective late plus the common adverb ending ly, with no Latin source.
intro.cn: 这是英语本土构词：古老形容词 late 加常见的副词词尾 ly，不涉及拉丁来源。

latinIntro.en: No Latin word stands behind it, so the list of Latin entries is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源，因此拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.example: The base word supplies the sense of time near now.
items.exampleCN: 基础词提供靠近现在的时间感。

items.example: The suffix turns the adjective into an adverb of time.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把形容词变成时间副词。

items.example: It marks the period just past.
items.exampleCN: 它标记刚刚过去的那段时间。

items.example: The comparative moves the sense forward in time.
items.exampleCN: 比较级把意思推向将来的时间。

items.example: The superlative picks the newest item of a series.
items.exampleCN: 最高级挑出一系列中最新的一项。

items.example: The noun keeps the sense of delay.
items.exampleCN: 派生名词保留「延迟」的意思。

items.example: It is the formal twin of this word.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个词正式的同义说法。

items.example: It stresses that the state is new.
items.exampleCN: 它强调状态之新。

items.meaning: very lately, of something just done
items.example: It often describes things just made or done.
items.exampleCN: 它常描述刚做好或刚完成的事物。

items.example: The frame turns the adverb into a period boundary.
items.exampleCN: 这个框架把副词变成时间段的边界。

derivatives.zh: 去掉副词词尾得到的基础形容词，义为「晚的；近期的」
加比较词尾 -er 构成，义为「后来；以后」
加最高级词尾 -est 构成，义为「最新的」
加名词词尾 -ness 构成，义为「迟到；迟」
